PEG ratio 0.41 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).

Margin operasi 36% dan masih melebar 5.3 poin dari tahun lalu — tanda pricing power dan keunggulan kompetitif (moat).

summary: Analog Devices, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, testing, and marketing of integrated circuits (ICs), software, and subsystems products in the United States, rest of North and South America, Europe, Japan, China, and rest of Asia. It provides data converter products, which translate real-world analog signals into digital data, as well as translates digital data into analog signals; power management and reference products for power conversion, driver monitoring, sequencing, and energy management applications in the automotive, communications, industrial, and consumer markets; and power
thesis: Analog Devices, Inc. memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 56/100) dengan keunggulan utama di kesehatan keuangan (72) dan kualitas bisnis (61). Titik lemahnya ada di valuasi (38). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $343.01 — potensi turun 16.2% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal sangat kuat (82/100). Risiko geopolitik sangat tinggi, terutama dari tema Kontrol Ekspor Chip & Selat Taiwan.
